said on Saturday that the company will unveil its long-delayed Roadster on Oct. 1, nearly a decade after teasing the next-generation sports car.
Tesla’s official account on X shared a graphic with the date and the caption “Go for launch.”
Go for launch
Musk later confirmed the news in a reply, writing, “New Tesla Roadster Unveil 10.01.”
New Tesla Roadster Unveil 10.01

The Information reported in August that Tesla was planning an unveiling as early as that month. According to the report, the event could feature a limited-edition Roadster equipped with cold-gas thrusters developed with
Space Exploration Technologies Corp
). The thrusters could potentially be demonstrated at SpaceX’s test site in McGregor, Texas.
A Program Years in the Making

Tesla first revealed the Roadster in 2017, targeting 2020 deliveries. The launch has slipped repeatedly since. Reports indicate the car evolved from a Model S Plaid-based design into an all-new carbon-fiber hypercar.
The reveal follows Tesla’s rollout of driverless rides in its
